import re
import sys

names = ["a", "b", "c", "d", "e", "f", "g", "h", "TMP"]
variables = {}

assignment = re.compile(
    r"(a|b|c|d|e|f|g|h|TMP)\s*<-\s*"
    r"(a|b|c|d|e|f|g|h|TMP|-?\d+)\s*;"
)

for line in sys.stdin:
    match = assignment.fullmatch(line.strip())
    if match:
        target, source = match.groups()
        variables[target] = (
            int(source) if re.fullmatch(r"-?\d+", source) else variables[source]
        )

print(" ".join(f"{name} ?= {variables[name]};" for name in names))
